title: docs(verify): the RLS probe grant holds its set by name, not by row id (#15196 S5c)
body:
Part of #15196
Clause-②: no

Stage **S5c** of #15196: `verify` reads the name column. Claimed by the epic PM lane in 6106687498 (the maintainer folded S5c in with 「并进来（推荐）」, recorded in #15204's amendment 6106681412). The card stays open; its other stages (S8a / S8b / S9) are untouched here.

## What was left of S5c on `main`

Measured on `origin/main` `9f5eca52b`:

- **No `verify` read keys a grant by row id.** `verify` writes the probe grant and reads nothing back from grants. The writer already sends both columns (`permission_set_id` and the name column `permission_set`) since S4a (#22100).
- **The resolver reads the name column only.** `resolveUserAuthzGrants` (`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`, section 6) collects `grantSetNameOf(grant)`, which reads `permission_set` alone, and takes each definition from the security catalog. Its comment states that "The grant's `permission_set_id` is not read".
- **No permission-set source reads a row.** `PermissionEvaluator.resolvePermissionSets` reads metadata, then the bootstrap list, then the `dbLoader` the security plugin passes. That loader is `catalogSetLoader` (`security-plugin.ts` around line 1984), which calls `securityCatalogReaderOf(ql).resolve('permission', name)`, the registry, not `sys_permission_set`.

So what S5c still owed was two comments in `packages/verify/src/rls.ts` that described the pre-ADR-0131 model as current:

1. `rlsProbeSecurity`'s docblock said the evaluator falls back to "the DB row only as a last resort", and that this loader drops `rowLevelSecurity`. Neither holds. The corrected text says why the probe set must be registered: a row-only set resolves nowhere and grants nothing.
2. The inline comment in `provisionRlsProbePersona` said "The grant is keyed by ROW ID, and `resolveUserAuthzGrants` reads the row only to learn its NAME". The corrected text says the grant holds its set by name. The set row is read only for the id that the still-required `permission_set_id` column takes. The platform derives the grant's name from that id and refuses a disagreement (`grant-permission-set-name.ts`).

The code is unchanged. Retiring the set-row read and mint is #15204 stage 4, which is its own PR.

## Changeset

Comments only, with no behaviour change, so this takes `skip-changeset` under the repo's comment fast lane.

## Verification

All at `740affb`:

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/verify...' build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify test`: 29 files, 234 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit` clean, and `check:test-typecheck` OK.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE`: 47 derived, 46 run, 1 NOT MEASURED.
  - The NOT MEASURED gate is `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET). It needs a whole-repo `pnpm build`, which is left to CI.
  - On their first run, `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone) and `check:dts-closure` (dist trees not yet built) refused their prerequisites. After `git fetch --unshallow` and the build, both re-ran at exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts` still says, on the `permission_set` field, that "the resolver in @objectstack/core still reads the id until its own stage switches it". S5a switched it, so that sentence is now false too. It is outside this lane's `packages/verify` file surface, so it is left for the next PR that touches that file. The grant door's `permission_set_id` goes in #15204 stage 8 or C7b.
